title: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss

result.label: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss
result.statement: Determines the optimal chromatic loss from geometric H -fixed points to geometric G -fixed points for every subgroup H of a finite p -group G . At every nonnegative height, the loss equals the shortest subnormal-chain length from H to G with cyclic quotients. Each quotient counts once regardless of order, and finite spectra witness sharpness.
